old_problem: IOHUB group/structure and errortype0 are implementation-specific, FF5/FFE encoding and safe mask are absent, and no authoritative corrected-bank/count/no-reset oracle exists.
disposition_reason: Generic MCA/APEI knowledge cannot decode AMD IOHUB group7/struct1, proprietary errortype0 or the threshold register encoding. These affect target identity, stimulus, escalation and rollback, not just runtime binding. ED-03/11/15/16 prohibit guessing a raw register or PASS signature. Pending/BLOCKED remains until CPU/tool and platform authorities provide the contract.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row69, exact AI/history2469, UCE companion and next row70.
Preserved IOHUB parity CE, Platform First, threshold, exact tuple and multi-OS evidence scope.
Required raw before/target/after values and mask instead of interpreting FF5/FFE as literal counts.
Defined CE acceptance as one attributable corrected event with no reset/escalation/service loss.
No BIOS/HDT/threshold write, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: IOHUB parity correctable error with threshold restoration
test_case.purpose: Inject one authoritative correctable parity event into each approved IOHUB structure, correlate the exact corrected MCA/APEI/WHEA source/count, prove no escalation and restore all threshold/RAS state.
required_package: Threshold register definition, mask and FF5/FFE encoding rationale
OS-specific corrected MCA/APEI/WHEA signature and counter oracle
OOB recovery and exact Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not change the threshold or inject. After approval, capture full raw settings, apply only the documented masked threshold delta, verify one mapped tuple, inject once, collect the exact corrected bank/source/count and service health, then clear stimulus and restore/compare every raw field.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one fresh corrected event identifies the intended IOHUB source within timeout and increments the approved counter; no UCE/fatal, SyncFlood, reset or device/service degradation occurs; threshold and all RAS controls return exactly to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until tuple, flag and threshold semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, broad parity text, wrong bank/source, missing count delta, reset/escalation or imperfect raw restoration fails.
safety_gate: No raw write without register width/mask and saved complete value.
One tuple/event at a time; abort on wrong source, storm, UCE/fatal, SyncFlood, reset or instability.
No automatic retry; preserve MCA and register evidence.
test_case.recovery: Stop injector, preserve MCA/BMC evidence, restore complete saved threshold and Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT state, verify platform/device health over OOB and escalate any reset or persistent error without retry. Execution remains blocked until approved.
